curriculum.name: Kenya Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC)
curriculum.tagline: Practical, value-driven, KICD-aligned learning for Kenyan families
curriculum.description: Approved by KICD for Junior Secondary School (JSS Grades 7-9).

term_package.title: Grade 7 JSS CBC - Term 1 Junior Secondary Box
term_package.subtitle: KICD JSS Aligned: Integrated Science, Pre-Technical Studies, Mathematics, Social Studies, English, Agriculture
features: 12 Comprehensive JSS Inquiry Modules Aligned with KNEC CBA
Pre-Technical Studies, Electrical Safety & Hand Tool Mastery
Integrated Science Laboratory Practicals using Household Reagents

learning_outcomes: Demonstrate laboratory safety precautions in a home lab
Distinguish physical properties of metals and non-metals

lessons.subject: Integrated Science
lessons.parent_script: Junior secondary science requires rigorous inquiry. Let us examine common danger hazard symbols found on household items.
lessons.learning_objective: Identify corrosive, flammable, toxic, and biohazard signs and explain home emergency protocols.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Inspect chemical labels for hazard warning symbols.
2. Draft a Home Lab Safety Protocol Charter.
3. Map emergency exits and first aid kit placement.

lessons.subject: Pre-Technical Studies
lessons.topic: Identification and Maintenance of Hand Tools
lessons.parent_script: Tools make human work efficient. Today we explore measuring, cutting, and driving tools in our workshop.
lessons.learning_objective: Classify tools into measuring, marking, cutting, and holding categories and describe rust prevention.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Categorize 5 household hand tools.
2. Measure dimensions of a timber piece.
3. Clean and oil metal hinges to prevent corrosion.

lessons.subject: Mathematics
lessons.parent_script: We apply prime numbers to solve real-world scheduling and grouping challenges.
lessons.learning_objective: Find LCM and GCD of 3-digit numbers using repeated division and prime factor trees.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Express 144, 180, and 240 as products of prime factors.
2. Calculate LCM for traffic light synchronizations.
3. Solve 5 application problems.
